ruling: U21g-27 (specification v0.13 §4.25) — the canonical record encodes every column of every event row; rule recorded in S015_CANONICAL_FORM_s015f3_RULE_v0_1.md
cardinality: eight vectors: seven re-derived from the Phase 2 s015f2 inputs (V1, V2, V3a, V3b, V3c, V4, V5) plus one additional obligation vector (V6)
authored_inputs_note: Columns the s015f2 record did not carry (id, predecessor_id, actor_id, authority_basis_id, the anchor FK, action, references, keys, temporal basis, obligation extras) hold authored values [A]; they are part of the published input. In a live table id and recorded_at are database-assigned.
grammar: Envelope   : ["s015f3","<anchor token>","<anchor identity uuid, lowercase hyphenated>",[<record>,<record>,...]]
Record     : JSON object {"<column>":<value>,...} containing EVERY column of the event table, keys in bytewise (C-collation) ascending order of the column name
timestamptz: UTC, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ" (exactly six fractional digits, four-digit zero-padded year), as a JSON string
uuid       : lowercase hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal, as a JSON string

varchar    : JSON string with the mandatory escapes only (" \\ and U+0000-U+001F; \b \t \n \f \r short forms; other controls \u00xx lowercase hex); non-ASCII as raw UTF-8 (Python json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False); PostgreSQL to_json(text)::text)
integer/bigint: JSON number, shortest decimal, optional leading '-', no quotes
NULL       : the literal null; the key is always present
boolean/json: no rule in s015f3 — no such column exists; the serialiser refuses
Order      : records ascending by (effective_at, occurred_at, received_at, recorded_at, sequence, event_uuid)
Eligible   : effective_at <= state_at AND received_at <= known_at AND recorded_at <= known_at (unchanged)
Bytes      : UTF-8, separators , and : with no whitespace anywhere
Digest     : "s015f3:" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes — 71 characters

vectors.title: eligibility, membership — E1 and future-effective E2 at (2026-10-02, 2026-10-02)
eligibility, membership — at (2026-10-02, 2026-09-01T09:00:00Z) E2's recorded_at exceeds known_at: E1 only (identical to V3a)
fold order is the sextuple, not the sequence — Circle; F2 (sequence 2) sorts before F1 on occurred_at, so F2's record-time predecessor set is empty and its prior_state is NULL
one obligation event carrying the four-member projection — under s015f3 every obligation column is a keyed member of the record
